description: A resource manifest applied to an Airdress operator.

namespace.description: Accepted for k8s familiarity but ignored — every operator manages one airdress's resources (one namespace).

resourceVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency token. When present, apply is rejected with 409 if the stored row's `resource_version` doesn't match. When absent, last-writer-wins.

spec.description: `spec` block of a `Function` manifest. The function is served at `POST /fn/<metadata.name>` on the operator.

bundle.description: The WebAssembly component bundle the operator loads. The operator never fetches a bundle; it must already be present in the operator's `functions.d` directory.

path.description: Bare file name inside the operator's `functions.d` directory — no directory separators, no `.` or `..` segments.

sha256.description: Optional hex SHA-256 of the bundle bytes. When set, a bundle whose digest differs is refused at load time and the `Loaded` condition reports it.

signer.description: Optional hex ed25519 public key the bundle's detached signature must verify against. An unsigned bundle loads only if the operator allows unsigned functions.

capabilities.description: Capabilities granted to the function. Every world is closed by default; only `http` is live on this operator version.

http.description: Outbound HTTP. `hosts` is an exact allowlist of FQDNs or operator alias keys — no wildcards.

hosts.description: Hosts the function may reach. Each entry is an exact FQDN or an operator alias key; `*` is never accepted.

identity.description: Reserved capability world `identity`. Not yet available on this operator: a manifest that grants it is accepted by the schema and refused at apply time until the operator serves it.

inbox.description: Reserved capability world `inbox`. Not yet available on this operator: a manifest that grants it is accepted by the schema and refused at apply time until the operator serves it.

kv.description: Reserved capability world `kv`. Not yet available on this operator: a manifest that grants it is accepted by the schema and refused at apply time until the operator serves it.

llm.description: Reserved capability world `llm`. Not yet available on this operator: a manifest that grants it is accepted by the schema and refused at apply time until the operator serves it.

log.description: Reserved capability world `log`. Not yet available on this operator: a manifest that grants it is accepted by the schema and refused at apply time until the operator serves it.

enabled.description: When `false`, the operator keeps the manifest but does not load the bundle or serve the route. Defaults to `true`.

limits.description: Per-invocation resource limits. Every field is optional and defaults on the operator.

cpuDeadlineMs.description: CPU time budget per invocation in milliseconds; an invocation past it is cancelled.

memoryMib.description: Linear memory ceiling per instance in MiB.

runtime.description: Component model runtime. `wasm-component/v1` is the only value this operator version serves.

title: Airdress operator Function manifest
